title: Velocity, Broken Grids, Glow Type, Echo Bursts & Native Scrollbars
description: Five live UI drops: scroll-velocity-reactive gallery, an intentionally broken editorial grid, lh/rlh-based glow type, echo-burst buttons, and native scrollbar theming.

drops.title: Velocity Gallery
drops.description: Cards skew and lag behind fast scrolling, settle flat when you slow down, and shift an ambient mood color as they cross viewport center.
drops.concept: Reimplements the mechanism behind Codrops' scroll-reactive 3D gallery — depth-layered cards, velocity-driven motion, and mood-based background color — in plain CSS/canvas-free vanilla JS instead of Three.js/WebGL. A requestAnimationFrame loop tracks scroll delta as velocity, decays it each frame, and maps it to a clamped skewY plus parallax offset per card; the nearest-to-center card's hue is eased into the page background.
drops.source: Inspired by Codrops' 'Building a Scroll-Reactive 3D Gallery with Three.js, Velocity, and Mood-Based Backgrounds' tutorial

interaction.mouse: Scroll to drive velocity-based skew and parallax
interaction.touch: Scroll/swipe drives the same velocity calculation

drops.title: Broken Grid Editorial
drops.description: Seven cards deliberately overlap, counter-rotate, and bleed past their grid lines in an asymmetric magazine layout — tune the chaos live.
drops.concept: 2026's design-trend wave leans into 'broken grids' — layouts that look like a rigid CSS grid was deliberately knocked askew. This drop places seven cards on an explicit CSS grid, then layers rotation, negative-margin overlap, mixed z-index, and one clip-path torn edge on top, all driven by CSS custom properties a debug panel can retune live, plus a reshuffle button for fresh chaos.
drops.source: Inspired by Envato Elements' 'Web design trends for 2026: kinetic type, broken grids and the return of visual personality' report

interaction.mouse: Hover a card to lift it flat and to the front
interaction.click: Reshuffle button randomizes each card's rotation
interaction.touch: Tap to bring a card forward

drops.title: Reactive Glow Type
drops.description: Letters glow brighter the closer your cursor gets — the glow radius is sized in 1lh so it matches every line's height regardless of font size.
drops.concept: The lh and rlh units reached CSS Baseline widely-available status in May 2026, finally giving a reliable way to size decorations relative to a line's actual rendered height instead of guessing in px or em. Each character gets a radial-gradient halo sized at exactly 1lh, so resizing the headline (or dropping to a smaller variant) keeps the glow proportionally identical without recalculating anything in JS. A root-relative accent bar uses rlh for the same reason at page scale.
drops.source: Built around the lh/rlh CSS units reaching Baseline in the May 2026 web.dev digest, plus 2026's kinetic/glow type effect trend

interaction.mouse: Move the cursor near letters to intensify their glow
interaction.touch: Drag a finger across the headline for the same effect

drops.title: Echo Burst Buttons
drops.description: Hover or tap a button and it fires 1-4 expanding, fading echo rings traced from its own outline, like a sonar ping.
drops.concept: 2026's button-hover trend roundups keep surfacing 'burst' effects — a brief expand-and-fade illusion on interaction. This drop builds that from first principles: each button holds a stack of ring elements matching its own border-radius, staggered with animation-delay so they fire like consecutive sonar pulses instead of one flash. A debug panel exposes ring count, duration, and pill-vs-square shape live.
drops.source: Riffs on the 'burst' button hover-effect family surveyed in 2026 CSS button design roundups

interaction.mouse: Hover a button to fire its echo rings

drops.title: Native Scrollbar Theming
drops.description: Three themed scrollable panels styled with only scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width — no ::-webkit-scrollbar hacks, no JS scrollbar library.
drops.concept: scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width shipped across all major browser engines, making cross-browser scrollbar theming a two-declaration CSS feature instead of vendor-prefixed pseudo-element workarounds or a JS scrollbar replacement library. Three preset panels (chat, code, playlist) each theme their scrollbar with a single rule pair, and a live builder lets you pick thumb color, track opacity, and width (auto/thin/none) to see the effect update in real time.
drops.source: Built around scrollbar-color/scrollbar-width reaching Baseline, per web.dev's announcement

interaction.mouse: Scroll any panel; pick a swatch or width in the live builder
interaction.touch: Scroll panels directly on touch devices
